scope: Known reports for identical regression reruns; open and closed states checked

issues.title: SQLite prepared INSERT assigns positional values to the wrong columns when the column list is reordered
ZtdMysqli::query() returns mysqli_result instead of true for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL
ZtdMysqli::query() returns int/float column values where native mysqli returns strings
ZtdMysqli: generated AUTO_INCREMENT keys cannot be read (`insert_id` throws, `SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()` returns 0)
ZtdMysqli: mysqli connection and statement properties throw `Error`, and `errno`/`error` stay empty after a failed `query()`
ZtdMysqli: constraint violations and syntax errors raise `ZtdMysqliException` (code 0) instead of `mysqli_sql_exception` with errno/SQLSTATE, and are thrown even under `MYSQLI_REPORT_OFF`
ZtdMysqli::stmt_init() returns a statement bound to the physical connection, so `$stmt->prepare()` bypasses the session (unknown table 1146)
ZtdMysqli::real_query() returns true but `store_result()` and `use_result()` return false, so a SELECT result cannot be read
ZtdMysqli::multi_query() is not applied to session tables: statements referencing a session-created table fail with unknown table 1146
ZtdMysqli: `fetch_fields()` metadata differs from native (INT/BOOLEAN reported as LONGLONG, no PRI_KEY/AUTO_INCREMENT/NOT_NULL flags, empty `orgtable`)
`new ZtdMysqli()` without arguments connects immediately (unlike `new mysqli()`), so `options()` cannot be set before `real_connect()`
